title: UP Scholarship Online Form 2025-26
organization: Social Welfare Department / Government of Uttar Pradesh
postName: UP Pre-Matric / Post-Matric / Other Scholarship Schemes 2025-26
vacancyDetails: Online scholarship application for SC/ST/OBC/General/Minority and other categories as per UP schemes
qualification: Studying in recognized institutions in UP; category and income criteria as per scheme
howToApply:
1. Visit https://scholarship.up.gov.in
2. Select Pre-Matric or Post-Matric scholarship
3. Register / login with Aadhaar-linked details
4. Fill form, upload income & caste certificates, mark sheets
5. Submit and track status online
shortDescription: UP Scholarship Online Form 2025-26 – apply for Pre/Post Matric scholarships at scholarship.up.gov.in.
content:
The Government of Uttar Pradesh runs online scholarship schemes for eligible students for the academic year 2025–26.

Applications are submitted on the official portal scholarship.up.gov.in. Students need valid Aadhaar, bank account, income certificate, caste certificate (if applicable) and educational documents.

Check scheme-wise last dates and eligibility carefully before submitting.
